status: PRE-REGISTERED before any Family A result exists; changes need owner approval
purpose: statistical credibility rules for Family A (HTF trend, volatility targeting, crypto/cash allocation) and Family B

multiple_testing.family_wise: Holm-Bonferroni at alpha 0.05 across the hypotheses registered for a family (one primary specification per family = 1 hypothesis; extra registered variants count)
multiple_testing.trial_count_rule: N = distinct strategy configurations ever evaluated on research data (experiment_ledger.json: 40) + configurations of the new family; every new evaluation increments N before its result is read
multiple_testing.dsr_variance: sampling variance 1/(n-1) of a Sharpe estimate under no skill (no per-trial Sharpe history exists for all earlier configurations)
multiple_testing.pbo: CSCV with 16 splits when a family has >= 2 registered configurations; otherwise not applicable (and then only 1 hypothesis may be registered)

credible_means: ALL of: T1-T10 pass (unchanged); lower bound of the 95 % block-bootstrap interval of net annualised Sharpe > 0; DSR >= 0.95; Holm rejects the null; PBO <= 0.25 where applicable; passes 2x cost stress; no single asset or regime supplies the result; sample not underpowered
underpowered_rule: if the smallest annualised Sharpe detectable at power 0.8 exceeds 1.5 the sample is 'underpowered': absence of significance is not evidence of absence and no claim of statistical significance is made
volatility_targeting: never evidence of alpha: a scaled series is always compared with the unscaled basket under identical costs; only the difference in risk-adjusted return counts and it must itself pass the screen
holdout: unchanged: 2025-07-01..2026-11-25, one evaluation per finalist after separate written approval
references_verified: Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado, Zhu 2017 J. Computational Finance 20(4) DOI 10.21314/JCF.2016.322
